subject.title: fix(cli): keep model status JSON clean under concurrent access

question: Should this protected CLI-routing change land after a maintainer independently confirms that the parent aliases remain isolated from model child and authentication commands?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the route intentionally changes startup and proxy behavior for an established CLI surface.

options.title: Review and land with live proof
options.body: Confirm the status aliases, explicit status command, child commands, and concurrent SQLite run behave as claimed, then merge the focused routing change.

options.title: Request narrower proof first
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or a linked artifact showing parsed JSON from simultaneous status invocations before making the merge decision.

recommendation.title: Review and land with live proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the status aliases, explicit status command, child commands, and concurrent SQLite run behave as claimed, then merge the focused routing change.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence ties this contributor directly to the affected CLI routing change; repository-history ownership could not be independently established from the available inspection path.
